name: AP_DISCOUNT_OFFERS_ASSIGN_
description: AP_DISCOUNT_OFFERS_ASSIGN contains information about the supplier assigned to the discount offer. AP_DISCOUNT_OFFERS_ASSIGN_ is the audit table for AP_DISCOUNT_OFFERS_ASSIGN.
